name: Cinching Hold
description: Tie a first knot round an opponent's soul and cinch it until the soul's movement slows.

name: Hitching Guard
description: Hitch a knot of force to the user's side where it catches a soul-strike and holds it.

name: Knotted Crossing
description: Pull on a knot fixed to a far soul and cross to it in a single stride.

name: Pulse Knot
description: Tie a knot to a soul and feel its pulse of force through the cord.

name: Tug Rap
description: Rap the knotted end against an opponent's soul with a sharp tug of the cord.

name: Constricting Knot
description: Tie a knot that tightens whenever the opponent calls up force so that every technique comes out weaker.

name: Unpicked Knot
description: Work the strands of a hostile binding loose on an ally until the ally's soul moves free again.

name: Lurking Snare
description: Lay a snare in an opponent's path that closes on the soul stepping into it.

name: Snare Veil
description: Spread the snare as a veil that tangles a soul-bolt and turns it off the user's line.

name: Snare Retreat
description: Leave a snare at the user's feet and back away behind it while the opponent works free.

name: Tripline Sense
description: Stretch fine lines of force across the field and feel which of them a soul disturbs.

name: Sprung Snare
description: Spring the laid snare on the first hostile soul to cross it and clench it fast.

name: Draining Noose
description: Draw a noose round a caught soul and let it bleed off the soul's strength a little at a time.

name: Paired Fetters
description: Close two fetters at once on an opponent's intent and reach so that the opponent cannot start a gesture.

name: Fetter Shield
description: Hold one fetter before the user as a plate against a soul-strike.

name: Fetter Leap
description: Throw a fetter to a high soul and use its pull to leap across the gap.

name: Fetter Gauge
description: Fit a fetter to a soul and read from its fit how large that soul is.

name: Clasped Wrist
description: Clasp the wrist of the opponent's forming technique so that it falters mid gesture.

name: Double Clasp
description: Clasp the opponent's reach and intent together so that no technique can be loosed for several breaths.

name: Fetter Lash
description: Lash both fetters across the opponent's soul in a crossing blow.

name: Linked Hands
description: Link the user's soul to an ally's so that a soul-strike aimed at either is shared between them.

name: Hand Hold
description: Take hold of an opponent's soul by the link and hold it still for a breath.

name: Pulled Along
description: Pull an ally along the link to the user's side in one step.

name: Chain Murmur
description: Let each link murmur what its soul feels so that the whole chain shares one sense of the field.

name: Pinch Link
description: Pinch a link tight on an opponent's soul so that it takes a sharp squeeze.

name: Steadying Chain
description: Run the chain through the allies so that each draws steadiness from the next and their techniques hold firm.

name: Spliced Burden
description: Spread the weight of a heavy soul-strike down the chain so that no single ally bears it whole.

name: Distant Tether
description: Cast a tether over a long reach and close it on a distant soul.

name: Tether Screen
description: Spin the tether into a screen before the user that blunts a distant soul-strike.

name: Reach Hitch
description: Hitch the tether to a far soul and be drawn across the gap in one step.

name: Tether Echo
description: Send a pulse down the tether and read what answers from the far soul.

name: Distant Snag
description: Snag a far opponent's forming technique with the tether before it is loosed.

name: Tether Pluck
description: Pluck the tether like a string so that a hard shiver runs along it into the far soul.

name: Held Distance
description: Hold a far opponent at the end of the tether so that the opponent can neither close nor cast freely.

name: Reeling Haul
description: Haul a far opponent in along the tether and off balance into the user's reach.
